items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I used to tell the singers, theatre,/hey, go down there and hear Rockland White... I used to go down

ctx.x: This was around 1913, '14, '15, '16, '17, see, all the big shots, people in show business would come down to this club and Rockland White, now they were at the and I used to tell the singers, theatre,/hey, go down there and hear Rockland White, they didn't go. I used to go down, and now they had a number named 'Mississippi' and the girl used to talk it like, see, M-i-s-s-i-s-s-i-p-p-i, that used to be so hard to spell, it

almost made me cry" and I forget the rest of it, but I knew the whole thing and they came down to the theatre, down to the club one night and the waiter says, Rock and White from the show is down here.
